purpose: #197: a Verilog-A module calls an analog system function a C VPI application registers (LRM 12.32); its calltf's value reaches the device

oracle.derivation: vpi_gain.c's calltf puts its argument back on the call, so $espice_gain(2.0) = 2.0 and the device is I = 2.0*V/1k: 500 ohm under 1 kohm from 1 V gives v(out) = 500/1500 = 1/3 V and i(vin) = -1/1500 A. A host that ignored the application (0) would give v(out) = 1 V; one that returned 1 would give 0.5 V.
